rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Finally, this moment's here. Time to pay you back for wrecking that trial!
rows.notes: 'trial' = the Trial that selected the YF-19/YF-21 (encyclopedia_022 text_id 85); kept lowercase to match that rendering.

rows.en: <operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>Calm down, <color(4)>Isamu<ce()>. This is a dangerous opponent.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Like hell I can calm down. I definitely had that win.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>No, it was my win.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>What'd you say?!
<operator(12061,2)><speed(2)>Okay! That's enough!
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>No fighting while we're working.
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Ahaha. Hi there. Backup number one, <color(4)>Hikaru Amano<ce()> here!
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Likewise, number two... <color(4)>Izumi Maki<ce()>.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>So you're the pilots that Lt. Cmdr. <color(4)>Hoshino<ce()> recommended.
rows.notes: 'Lt. Cmdr. Hoshino' per locked shousa rendering (terms_028, matches 4004463).

rows.en: <operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>That's right! Along with <color(4)>Ruri-Ruri<ce()>, nice to meet you!
rows.notes: 'Ruri Ruri' is Hikaru's affectionate doubling of Ruri (Hoshino); rendered 'Ruri-Ruri'.

rows.en: <operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Are the people called <color(4)>Skull Squadron<ce()> also comrades who fought alongside you?
rows.notes: 'Skull Squadron' per Macross role wording already used for Hikaru Ichijyo/Max/Roy Focker in character_names_021.

rows.en: <operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah. <color(4)>Skull Squadron<ce()> was stationed aboard the <color(4)>Macross<ce()> back then.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Once they heard the <color(4)>Macross<ce()> was in danger, I doubt they could sit still.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Their skills are considerable too.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>...Though their personalities might be a little odd.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I-is that so...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Marina<ce()>, do you know anything about that <color(5)>black unit<ce()>?
rows.notes: '-san' on Marina dropped per corpus convention; 'black unit' is a plain descriptor, not a proper noun.

rows.en: <operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>No... From what I hear it doesn't even have a Guardian, so it's a different beast from this <color(4)>Gun Ark<ce()>.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Everyone here is struggling against it, so it's possible it's exceeding its original specs.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Can we even beat a machine like that...
<operator(1020,2)><speed(2)>It'll be fine. You've survived this far, so have some confidence in your skill.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...Right!
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Guld<ce()>, follow behind me like a little chick, would you?
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>So worried about your own back, huh? Guess I could watch it for you, then.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>What did you say?!
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>What are you getting mad about? You're the one who told me to guard your back.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>You never shut up, do you! And another thing, you...
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>All right, break it up, you two lovebirds!
rows.notes: 'nakayoshi' (getting along so well) said sarcastically about their bickering; rendered as 'lovebirds' teasing.

rows.en: <operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>So the enemy's a drone running on AI. What do you think, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>What do I think... I fight stuff like that all the time in games, so it doesn't scare me.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>When it comes to reading movement, no way it can match a human.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>That's a real gamer's way of thinking.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Reality doesn't work out that easily.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I know that. I've racked up plenty of battle experience myself.
<operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Hey, you two have been out of it a while - you gonna be okay?
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>It's fine, it's fine! Bring on the drone fighters, whatever!
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>This kind of thing is like riding a bike. Once you learn it, you never forget.
<operator(12061,2)><speed(2)>Besides, if they're calling in even me, Earth must be in pretty serious trouble, huh?
<operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Yeah... pretty much.
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Then I'd better give it my all here, or I won't be able to draw manga in peace!
<operator(10020,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Hikaru<ce()>, <color(4)>Izumi<ce()>! Been a while!
rows.notes: '-chan' on both names dropped per corpus convention.

rows.en: <operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Ahaha! It's been a while!
<operator(10020,2)><speed(2)>Bet it's been a while since your last battle - you doing okay?
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>If it looks bad, we'll back you up, so don't hesitate to call out, okay?
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>It's fine, it's fine! I haven't gotten that rusty!
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Old skills die hard, as they say.
rows.notes: 'mukashi totta kinezuka' idiom (a skill once mastered is never lost) rendered as the closest English idiom.
